Class SessionFilterService

java.lang.Object
gui.frontend.services.SessionFilterService
public class SessionFilterService extends Object
Service for filtering and suggesting sessions to students. Provides: - Search by specialization, date, time - Filter by capacity, campaign status - Get alternative suggestions when preferred session is full - Sort by various criteria (date, capacity, preference)

    • checkScheduleConflict

      public boolean checkScheduleConflict(int studentId, Session newSession)
      Check if a new session conflicts with existing student registrations. A conflict occurs when: - The new session is on the same day as an existing registration - The time slots overlap
      Parameters:
      studentId - The student ID
      newSession - The session the student wants to register for
      Returns:
      true if there's a conflict, false otherwise
